proposal.summary: CM550 answers J1939 Request (PGN 59904) messages through a 32-entry table at 0x801d5a. Each entry is 6 bytes: a 16-bit PGN key at +0 and a handler pointer at +2. The entry count is a BYTE at 0x801e1a, right after the table. The RAM dump shows 24 entries in registration order, with DM1 registered twice, as in CM848. registerJ1939PgnRequestHandler (0x2f47e) appends entries and is a step-for-step twin of CM848 0x23188. cm550_dispatchJ1939PgnRequest (0x2f4be) is the 0xea00 receive handler: it matches request data bytes 0-1 against the table and calls the handler, or sends a NACK (PGN 59392). It is a counterpart of CM848 0x231cc, which also sets j1939_dm1_active_flag. cm550_registerJ1939PgnRequestHandlers (0x2f538, was cm550_diagnosticDataDump) registers the dispatcher and 21 of the 24 handlers. The other three come from the descriptor set-ups in mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink. Each responder builds and sends one message. DM5, DM10 and VI match CM848 step for step. DM1, DM2 and CCSS do not, so their shared names were wrong. The range also holds the J1939 receive registrations (PGN 61184, TSC1, ETC1, DM7), the engine retarder TSC1 path and the remote throttle claim.

functions.role: Appends a requested PGN and the function that answers it to the PGN 59904 request table j1939_pgn_dispatch_table.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of 0x801d5a / 0x801e1a: a byte count compared with 32 and 6-byte entries (word key + long handler). Its siblings registerJ1939ReceiveHandler (0x21272) and registerJ1939DiagnosticService (0x2ee62) fill other tables.
functions.plate_comment: Registers a PGN 59904 request handler. When j1939_pgn_handler_count is 32 it stores nothing and returns 1. Otherwise it writes the requested PGN's low 16 bits (the word argument, e.g. 0xfee4) to entry +0 and the handler (the long argument) to +2 of j1939_pgn_dispatch_table[count], adds 1 to the count and returns 0; no caller reads the result. This ROM makes 24 registrations (the RAM dump count is 24): the descriptor set-ups of mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink and cm550_registerJ1939PgnRequestHandlers. Twin of CM848 0x23188 (was cm848_j1939RegisterPgnHandler): one shared name.
functions.evidence: CM550 0x2f480 movea.l #0x801e1a,a1 / 0x2f486 cmpi.b #0x20,(a1) / 0x2f48c moveq #1,d0 rts / 0x2f492 move.b (a1),d0 / 0x2f494 addq.b #1,(a1) / 0x2f49c-0x2f4a2 count x 6 / 0x2f4a4 movea.l #0x801d5a,a0 / 0x2f4ae move.w (0x8,a7),(a2) / 0x2f4b2 move.l (0xa,a7),(0x2,a2) / 0x2f4b8 clr.b d0 / rts 0x2f4bc. CM848 0x23188: lbz r7 from 0x3faa62 / cmpwi r7,32 / li r3,1 / mulli r11,r7,6 / r6 = 0x3fa9a2 + r11 / stb r7+1 to 0x3faa62 / sth r3,0(r6) / stw r4,2(r6) / li r3,0. Same steps in the same order with the same constants (32, 6, the PGN halfword at +0 and the handler at +2) and the same callers' role. CM550 callers: 16 jsr (0x2f47e).l (0x2ef40, 0x31f26, 0x32142, 0x32290, 0x32412, 0x32580, 0x32a36, 0x32b2e, 0x330b8, 0x337ba, 0x338e0, 0x33b36, 0x33d2e, 0x342e6, 0x34426, 0x3448c) plus 7 jsr (a2) in 0x2f538 (a2 = 0x2f47e at 0x2f53a). There is no function row yet; it ends at the rts at 0x2f4bc. RAM dump: byte 0x801e1a = 24, and entries 0-23 at 0x801d5a match the registrations in call order.

functions.role: The PGN 59904 Request receive handler: it finds the requested PGN in j1939_pgn_dispatch_table and calls its handler, or NACKs.
functions.discriminator: The only reader of the 0x801d5a table (scan bound = the byte 0x801e1a). 0x2f538 registers it for 0xea00 (0x2f540). It is the only J1939 dispatcher that keys on request data bytes 0-1.
functions.plate_comment: The PGN 59904 Request receive handler, registered for 0xea00 by cm550_registerJ1939PgnRequestHandlers. For a request addressed to j1939_engine_node_source_address or global (0xff), it scans j1939_pgn_dispatch_table up to j1939_pgn_handler_count. It looks for the entry whose PGN bytes match request data bytes 0 and 1 (the data page byte is not compared) and calls that handler with the request. With no match and a request that was not global, it sends a negative acknowledgement through cm550_diagnosticCanResponseSender(request, 1) (PGN 59392). The CM848 counterpart cm848_j1939DispatchPgnHandler also sets j1939_dm1_active_flag before the call.
functions.evidence: Registered at 0x2f540-0x2f54a (pea 0x2f4be / move.w #0xea00 / jsr 0x21272). 0x2f4d2-0x2f4e4: ID byte 2 (the destination) compared with (0x80da01) or 0xff, else return. Loop 0x2f4ec-0x2f516: a2 = 0x801d5a, +6 per entry, bound d3 = (a4) = 0x801e1a. If entry +1 == data[0] and entry +0 == data[1], it pushes the request and jsr (a0) with a0 = entry +2, then exits. 0x2f518-0x2f52a: index == count and destination != 0xff -> jsr 0x31b22 with (request, 1). 0x31b22 sends header 0xe8ff00 (PGN 59392) with control byte d1 and the request's data bytes 0-2 as the PGN field. CM848 0x231cc has the same address test (0x231e8-0x23204), the same scan (lbz 1(r31) vs data[0], lbz 0(r31) vs data[1]) and the same NACK (0x23288-0x2329c, bl 0x23dbc with 1). CM848 has one extra step: li 1 / stb to 0x40ad53 (j1939_dm1_active_flag) before blrl (0x23248-0x23250). CM550 lacks it -> counterpart. The existing funcdef row (rx_msg can_std_rx_desc_t*) needs its function_name updated.

functions.role: Start-up: registers the PGN 59904 dispatcher and the request handlers of the on-request messages, directly or through their transmit descriptor set-ups.
functions.discriminator: Of the J1939 start-up registration calls, this is the only one that registers 0xea00 and drives registerJ1939PgnRequestHandler (a2 = 0x2f47e). It dumps no diagnostic data.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink. It registers cm550_dispatchJ1939PgnRequest for PGN 59904 with registerJ1939ReceiveHandler, then calls initPgn65261CruiseControlSetupStruct. It then calls eight descriptor set-ups that each register their responder: 65259, 65253, 65262, 65257, 65244, 65248, 65255, 65260. It registers seven responders directly with registerJ1939PgnRequestHandler: 65252, 65261, 65263, 65264, 65269, 65270, 65271. Last come the DM set-ups DM1 / DM2 / DM3 / DM4 / DM5 / DM10. Entries 3-23 of j1939_pgn_dispatch_table come from here. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_initJ1939ProtocolHandlers, which registers a different message set.
functions.evidence: 0x2f53a movea.l #0x2f47e,a2. 0x2f540-0x2f54a registerJ1939ReceiveHandler(0xea00, 0x2f4be). jsr 0x31fee, 0x320f6, 0x33754, 0x33880, 0x33aea, 0x33ce2, 0x3429a, 0x343d2, 0x34440 (0x2f550-0x2f580). These register 0x32052 / 0x33716 / 0x337c4 / 0x33a62 / 0x33c6c / 0x34232 / 0x34394 / 0x34430, at 0x32138 / 0x337b0 / 0x338d6 / 0x33b2c / 0x33d24 / 0x342dc / 0x3441c / 0x34482. 0x2f586-0x2f5d8: seven pea handler / move.w #pgn / jsr (a2): 0xfee4 0x33d38, 0xfeed 0x31f30, 0xfeef 0x33164, 0xfef0 0x33f5a, 0xfef5 0x31bce, 0xfef6 0x33e58, 0xfef7 0x342f0. lea (0x30,a7),a7 pops 48 bytes. Then 0x323be (DM1), 0x3252c (DM2), 0x2ef36 (DM3), 0x329d2 (DM4), 0x32ae2 (DM5), 0x32244 (DM10). Its only caller is mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink (jsr at 0x28e2c, after 0x2f114 and before 0x2efbc). CM848 0x232b4 has the same shape at the same place (cm848_j1939_system_init bl at 0x539514): registerJ1939ReceiveHandler(0xea00, 0x231cc), initPgn65261CruiseControlSetupStruct, five set-ups (65259 65262 65242 65248 65260), seven direct registrations (65261 65263 65264 65269 65270 65271 65504), then DM1 DM2 DM3 DM4 DM5 DM10. Different message set -> counterpart. RAM dump entries 3-23 = these registrations in this order.

functions.role: 20 ms task: gives the alternate throttle to the remote throttle (at its calibrated priority) while the remote throttle is selected, and takes it back otherwise.
functions.discriminator: The only CM550 writer of commanded_throttle_state.alternate_throttle / alternate_throttle_priority that uses the remote throttle priority CTRMTHPZ (0x8089a4) and remote_throttle_sensor_state.filtered_value. It is also the only writer that latches remote_throttle_active_flag from the remote throttle switch RMTHSW.
functions.plate_comment: The remote throttle's claim on the alternate throttle (20 ms task set). With algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.remote_throttle_enable off it releases a claim it holds: alternate_throttle_priority equal to CTRMTHPZ (0x8089a4) -> priority 0 and alternate throttle 0. With the enable on and remote_throttle_transition_verification_enable off, the remote throttle switch (0x80bcd0 bit 3, e2m 000E +2 RMTHSW) decides. Switch on: it claims (priority = CTRMTHPZ, alternate_throttle = remote_throttle_sensor_state.filtered_value). Switch off: it drops the priority. With verification on, remote_throttle_active_flag goes to 1 when the switch is on and the remote throttle is at or below the calculated commanded throttle. It goes to 0 when the switch is off and the remote throttle is at or above it, or, with fault status word 3 bit 0x800 set and the word at 0x806046 bit 0x800 clear, as soon as the remote throttle reaches it. The flag then claims or releases as the switch does. CM848 splits this into cm848_verifyRemoteThrottleTransition and cm848_claimRemoteThrottleOverride.
functions.evidence: Caller: cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase0 (jsr at 0x1b558). 0x2ec6c-0x2ec78 andi.l #0x1000 of 0x803cb8 (algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal, bit 12 remote_throttle_enable). If 0: 0x2ec7a-0x2ec84 cmp alternate_throttle_priority 0x80aa90 with CTRMTHPZ 0x8089a4 (e2m 1171 +0), then clr.w both 0x80aa90 and 0x80aa8e. 0x2ec90-0x2ec9c andi.l #0x2000 (bit 13). If 0: btst #3 of 0x80bcd0 (RMTHSW). On: 0x2ecb0 priority = CTRMTHPZ and 0x2ecb2 alternate = 0x80a3a4 when below. Off: 0x2ecc6 clr.w priority when equal. 0x2ecce-0x2ed30 latch 0x801c78 (set 0x2ecfe, clear 0x2ed1e / 0x2ed30) from 0x80a3a4 vs 0x80aa92 (calculated_commanded_throttle), the switch bit, 0x806006 & 0x800 and 0x806046 & 0x800. 0x2ed36 cmpi.w #1 flag -> claim (0x2ed46-0x2ed48) or release (0x2ed5a). CM848: cm848_claimRemoteThrottleOverride (0x50e610, from cm848_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase2) mirrors fault bits 77 / 78 into 171 / 172 and calls cm848_verifyRemoteThrottleTransition (0x50e534) for the flag. It only claims and never releases -> counterpart (same role, different steps). Dump: 0x803cb8 = 0x303a (both enables on), CTRMTHPZ = 5.

functions.role: Start-up: clears remote_throttle_active_flag, the remote throttle transition latch of cm550_claimRemoteThrottleOverride.
functions.discriminator: Its only store is clr.w 0x801c78. The only other user of 0x801c78 is 0x2ec50.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of mc68k_applicationMain: clears remote_throttle_active_flag (0x801c78), the transition latch that cm550_claimRemoteThrottleOverride sets and tests. CM848's counterpart cm848_initializeRemoteThrottle clears remote_throttle_transition_verified_flag and, with the remote throttle disabled, the remote throttle fault bits 171 / 172.
functions.evidence: 0x2ed62 clr.w (0x801c78).l / rts. Single caller: jsr at 0x2882e in mc68k_applicationMain's start-up list (0x28810-0x2884c). The other users of 0x801c78 are inside 0x2ec50 (0x2ecfe / 0x2ed1e / 0x2ed30 / cmpi.w at 0x2ed36). CM848 0x50e768 (called from cm848_applicationMain) also clears fault_detected_cal / fault_registered_cal bits 0x1800 when the remote throttle is disabled -> counterpart.

functions.role: The DM7 (PGN 58112 Command Non-continuously Monitored Test) receive handler: records the test identifier and answers with a DM8 test result or a NACK.
functions.discriminator: It is the PGN 58112 handler (0x2efbc registers it for 0xe300), the only writer of the byte 0x801d3c and the only caller of the DM8 sender 0x32b38. The other receive handlers in the range serve 61184 / 0 / 61442 / 59904.
functions.plate_comment: Receives a DM7 command (PGN 58112, registered by registerJ1939Dm7Handler) and stores data byte 0, the test identifier (SPN 1224), in j1939_dm7_test_identifier. For identifier 0 with bit 0x100 of supported_non_continuous_monitors_bits (e2m 1228 +8 JCNTCTMR) it sends a DM8 test result (PGN 65232, 0x32b38) with test 0 and value 0x100. For identifier 1 with bit 0x200 it sends test 1 with value 0x200. Any other request gets a negative acknowledgement (cm550_diagnosticCanResponseSender with 1). CM848's counterpart sends the intake air heater / misfire monitor results as the values and NACKs only identifiers 0 and 1.
functions.evidence: Registered at 0x2efbc (pea 0x2ef4a / move.w #0xe300 / jsr 0x21272). 0x2ef4e movea.l (0x10,a7),a2. 0x2ef5e-0x2ef62 move.b (data_ptr) -> (a3) = 0x801d3c. 0x2ef64-0x2ef76: identifier 0 and (0x60fa8) & 0x100 -> 0x32b38(0, 0x100). 0x2ef84-0x2ef9a: identifier 1 and & 0x200 -> 0x32b38(1, 0x200). 0x32b38 writes the identifier to 0x803470 and byteSwap16(value) to 0x803472, then sends 0x803462 (header 0xfed000, PGN 65232, at 0x32b70). Otherwise 0x2efa8-0x2efae jsr 0x31b22(request, 1). CM848 0x227a0 stores the same byte (stb to 0x3fa97a j1939_dm7_test_identifier) but passes intake_air_heater_monitor_result (0x40ad82) / misfire_monitor_result (0x40ad84) as the values. It NACKs only when the identifier is <= 1 (cmpwi r5,1 / bgt at 0x22820) -> counterpart. The existing funcdef row (msg_ptr int) should become the prototype given in prototypes[].

functions.role: Decodes the TSC1 requested torque byte (SPN 518, offset -125 %) into a retarding percent 0-100.
functions.discriminator: Only the engine retarder TSC1 processor calls it (twice: torque control and torque limit modes). It maps the byte below 25 to 100, 25-124 to 125 minus the byte, and 125 or more to 0.
functions.plate_comment: Decodes the TSC1 requested torque / torque limit byte (data byte 4, SPN 518: 1 % per bit, offset -125 %) into a retarding magnitude: 100 below 25 (-100 % or more), 125 minus the byte from 25 to 124, and 0 from 125 (zero or positive torque). cm550_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request calls it in torque control mode and in torque limit mode. Twin of CM848 0x2346c (was cm848_decodeRetarderTorqueRequestPercent): one shared name.
functions.evidence: CM550 0x2f60c cmpi.b #0x19,d2 / bcc / moveq #100. 0x2f618 cmpi.b #0x7d / bcs to compute / clr.w d0. 0x2f624-0x2f62a moveq #125 - byte. Callers: bsr.w at 0x2f980 (mode 2) and 0x2fa5a (mode 3) inside 0x2f7e6, each with the TSC1 byte 4 copy 0x801e21; the result goes to 0x80d9f2. No absolute reference. CM848 0x2346c: cmpwi 25 / bge, li 100; cmpwi 125 / blt, li 0; subfic 125. The same tests in the same order with the same constants. Its only caller is cm848_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request, twice (torque control / limit) -> twin. Funcdef rows 0x2f606 (return / requested_torque) need their function_name updated.

functions.role: Start-up: resets the engine retarder TSC1 request state and sets up the five retarder stage torque lookups.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of 0x801e28 (the cylinder brake count sum) and of the five lookup records 0x801e30-0x801e75 (pointers and offset). It runs once, right after the PGN 65249 descriptor set-up.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink, right after cm550_initializePgn65249RetarderConfigurationBuffer. It sets retarder_torque_percent = 125, retarder_control_mode = 0 (TSC1_OVERRIDE_OFF) and engine_retarder_control_device_indicator = 0. It stores the sum of the six engine brake driver cylinder counts (0x808200-0x80820a) in engine_retarder_stage_count. It fills the lookup records engine_retarder_torque_stage_1..5_lookup with the axis engine_retarder_torque_engine_speed_axis, the stage values and offset 2. CM848's counterpart starts the torque limit at 100 and sets only the cached axis offsets.
functions.evidence: Caller: jsr at 0x28c1e in mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink, after 0x341e6 (0x28c18). CM848 calls 0x23a9c at 0x539278, after 0x2682c cm848_initializePgn65249RetarderConfigurationBuffer (0x539274). 0x2fac0 move.w #0x7d -> 0x80d9ee. 0x2fac8 / 0x2face clr.w 0x80d9e4 / 0x80d9e6. 0x2fad4-0x2faf8 add.w of 0x808200..0x80820a -> 0x801e28 (6 in the dump). 0x2fafe-0x2fb62 x_axis_pointer 0x6052a, y values 0x60534 / 0x6053e / 0x60548 / 0x60552 / 0x6055c and x_axis_offset 2 into 0x801e30 / 3e / 4c / 5a / 68. CM848 0x23a9c: li 100 / sth to 0x40ad62 (not 125), two zero stores, the same six-word sum into 0x3faa72, and 2 into the five cache words 0x3faa7a-0x3faa82, with no axis / value pointers -> counterpart.

functions.role: Start-up: registers dispatchTsc1ByDestinationAddress as the receive handler of TSC1 (PGN 0).
functions.discriminator: Of the one-call registration wrappers (0x2ef08 61184, 0x2f114 61442, 0x2efbc 58112, 0x2ef36 65228), this one registers PGN 0 with 0x2fb70.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of the J1939 datalink set-up (the second registration call): registers dispatchTsc1ByDestinationAddress for PGN 0 (TSC1) with registerJ1939ReceiveHandler. Twin of CM848 0x23bb4 (was cm848_initJ1939AddressDispatcher): one shared name.
functions.evidence: 0x2fbb2 pea (0x2fb70).l / clr.w -(a7) / jsr (0x21272).l / addq.l #6,a7 / rts. CM848 0x23bb4: r4 = 0x23b38, li r3,0, bl 0x538eb0 (registerJ1939ReceiveHandler). Both are the second registration call of the J1939 start-up: CM550 jsr at 0x28e20 after 0x2ef08, CM848 bl at 0x539508 after 0x221f0 -> twin.

functions.role: The TSC1 (PGN 0) receive handler: routes the frame to the engine TSC1 processor and/or the engine retarder TSC1 processor by its destination address.
functions.discriminator: The only caller of processEngineTsc1Request (0x2f128) and of the retarder processor 0x2f7e6. It compares ID byte 2 with the engine (0x80da01) and the retarder (0x80da0b) source addresses.
functions.plate_comment: The TSC1 (PGN 0) receive handler, registered by registerTsc1DestinationAddressDispatcher. A frame addressed to j1939_engine_node_source_address or global (0xff) goes to processEngineTsc1Request. Then a frame addressed to j1939_retarder_node_source_address (41 here) or global goes to cm550_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request. Twin of CM848 0x23b38: one shared name.
functions.evidence: 0x2fb78 move.b (0x2,a2),d2 (ID byte 2). 0x2fb7c cmp.b (0x80da01) / cmpi.b #0xff -> jsr 0x2f128 (0x2fb8c). 0x2fb94 cmp.b (0x80da0b) / cmpi.b #0xff -> jsr 0x2f7e6 (0x2fba4). Retarder SA = 0x29 in the dump. Only reference: the pea at 0x2fbb4. CM848 0x23b38: lbz r31,2(r30); j1939_source_address low byte or 255 -> bl 0x22d60 (processEngineTsc1Request); j1939_engine_retarder_source_address or 255 -> bl 0x236f0. The same steps in the same order with the same constant, registered for PGN 0 by the twin wrappers -> twin. CM848 has two funcdef rows for 0x23b38 (lines 87 and 244) to retarget.

functions.role: Start-up: registers the PGN 61184 (Proprietary A) diagnostic service dispatcher with the J1939 receive layer.
functions.discriminator: Among the one-call registration wrappers it registers PGN 61184 (0xef00) with 0x2eea2, the scanner of j1939_diagnostic_service_table.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of the J1939 datalink set-up (the first registration call): registers cm550_diagnosticServiceDispatcher (the j1939_diagnostic_service_table scanner) for PGN 61184 with registerJ1939ReceiveHandler. Twin of CM848 0x221f0 (was cm848_initJ1939DiagnosticServiceHandler): one shared name.
functions.evidence: 0x2ef08 pea (0x2eea2).l / move.w #0xef00,-(a7) / jsr (0x21272).l / addq.l #6 / rts. CM848 0x221f0: r4 = 0x22128 (cm848_j1939DiagnosticServiceHandler), r3 = 61184, bl 0x538eb0. Both are the first registration of the start-up (CM550 jsr at 0x28e1a, CM848 bl at 0x539504) -> twin. The CM848 funcdef row (return void) needs its function_name updated.

functions.role: Start-up: registers the DM7 (PGN 58112) receive handler.
functions.discriminator: Among the one-call registration wrappers it registers PGN 58112 (0xe300) with 0x2ef4a.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of the J1939 datalink set-up: registers cm550_receivePgn58112Dm7CommandNonContinuouslyMonitoredTestMessage for PGN 58112 (DM7) with registerJ1939ReceiveHandler. Twin of CM848 0x22840: one shared name (CM848's name without its prefix).
functions.evidence: 0x2efbc pea (0x2ef4a).l / move.w #0xe300,-(a7) / jsr (0x21272).l / addq.l #6 / rts. CM848 0x22840: r4 = 0x227a0, r3 = 58112, bl 0x538eb0. Both run after the request handler registration list: CM550 jsr at 0x28e32 right after 0x2f538; CM848 bl at 0x539520 after 0x232b4 and two CM848-only registrations (0x2343c PGN 56832, 0x22318 DM13) -> twin.

functions.role: Start-up: registers the ETC1 (PGN 61442) receive handler and nothing else.
functions.discriminator: Among the one-call registration wrappers it registers PGN 61442 (0xf002) with cm550_receivePgn61442ElectronicTransmissionController1Message (0x2efd0).
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of the J1939 datalink set-up (the third registration call): registers cm550_receivePgn61442ElectronicTransmissionController1Message for PGN 61442 (ETC1) with registerJ1939ReceiveHandler. CM848's counterpart also initializes the ETC1 timeout, output shaft speed timer and fault hold-off state before it registers.
functions.evidence: 0x2f114 pea (0x2efd0).l / move.w #0xf002,-(a7) / jsr (0x21272).l / addq.l #6 / rts. Third registration call (jsr at 0x28e26). CM848 0x22bc4 (bl at 0x53950c) first zeroes etc1_message_timeout (sth at 0x22bd8), loads the output shaft speed power-up timeout (0x22be4-0x22be8), sets the hold-off flag (0x22bf4) and clears fault bits when vehicle_speed_sensor_type_cal is 4 (0x22bfc-0x22c28). Only then does it register cm848_j1939ProcessPgn61442Etc1 -> counterpart.

functions.role: Start-up: registers the DM3 (PGN 65228) request handler with the PGN 59904 request registrar.
functions.discriminator: The only registration of 0xfecc. It transmits nothing; the name canTransmissionTrigger was wrong.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of cm550_registerJ1939PgnRequestHandlers (between the DM2 and DM4 set-ups): registers cm550_j1939HandlePgn65228Dm3ClearInactiveFaults for PGN 65228 (DM3) with registerJ1939PgnRequestHandler. Twin of CM848 0x22770 (was cm848_initPgn65228Dm3Handler): one shared name.
functions.evidence: 0x2ef36 pea (0x2ef1c).l / move.w #0xfecc,-(a7) / jsr (0x2f47e).l / addq.l #6 / rts. Called at 0x2f5ea between 0x3252c (DM2) and 0x329d2 (DM4). CM848 0x22770: r4 = 0x22674, r3 = 65228, bl 0x23188, called by cm848_initJ1939ProtocolHandlers between the DM2 and DM4 set-ups -> twin. RAM dump entry 20 = 0xfecc / 0x2ef1c.

functions.role: Quantizes the decoded TSC1 retarder torque request into a retarder stage percent (0 / 17 / 33 / 50 / 67 / 83 / 100) from the stage torque curves at the current engine speed.
functions.discriminator: The only reader of 0x801e28 (cmpi.w #4) and of the five stage lookup records. It writes retarder_torque_level_stepped. It has nothing to do with multi-frame transport.
functions.plate_comment: Quantizes the retarder torque request jcomm_req_torque_braking_override_or_limit_value_0_125 into a stage percent in retarder_torque_level_stepped. A request of 0 gives 0, and a request of 100 or more in torque limit mode (3) gives 100. Otherwise it takes index = count, increments the count first, then writes the key word to 0x801d5a + 6 x index and the handler at entry + 2, and returns 0. It is called 17 times directly and 7 times through a2 from 0x2f538. The RAM dump holds 24 entries (count 0x18).
roles.discriminator: Third member of the registrar family. registerJ1939ReceiveHandler (0x21272) fills 0x800ab0 with 16 entries and registerJ1939DiagnosticService (0x2ee62) fills 0x801c7a with a byte key. This one fills table 0x801d5a / count 0x801e1a, and only the PGN 59904 dispatcher 0x2f4be reads that table.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_j1939RegisterPgnHandler @ 0x23188: TWIN. The same steps in the same order: lbz count, cmpwi 32 -> return 1, count*6 + table 0x3fa9a2, stb count+1 before the entry stores, sth key at +0, stw handler at +2, return 0. Both are called by the descriptor set-ups and the registration list. Both rows take the one unprefixed name.

roles.role: The PGN 59904 (Request) receive handler, registered for key 0xea00 by 0x2f538. It acts only when the request's destination byte (rx + 2) is j1939_engine_node_source_address (0x80da01) or 0xff. It scans the count-byte (0x801e1a) entries of 0x801d5a for one whose byte 1 equals request data byte 1 (data[0], PGN bits 0-7) and whose byte 0 equals data byte 2 (data[1], PGN bits 8-15). The data page byte is not compared. On a match it calls the entry's handler with the request record and stops. With no match and a request that was not global, it sends a negative acknowledgement: cm550_diagnosticCanResponseSender(rx, 1), PGN 59392.
roles.discriminator: The only reader of table 0x801d5a. It picks a responder by the requested PGN. The PGN 61184 dispatcher 0x2eea2 picks by a service byte, and 0x2fb70 picks by destination address.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_j1939DispatchPgnHandler @ 0x231cc: COUNTERPART. The same scan, match and NACK steps, but CM848 also stores 1 to 0x40ad53 (j1939_dm1_active_flag) before it calls the handler. CM848's DM3 responder reads that flag to choose its acknowledgement path and clears it. CM550 has no such flag.

Then initPgn65261CruiseControlSetupStruct (descriptor only). Then 8 descriptor set-ups, each of which registers its responder: 65259 0x320f6, 65253 0x33754, 65262 0x33880, 65257 0x33aea, 65244 0x33ce2, 65248 0x3429a, 65255 0x343d2, 65260 0x34440. Then 7 direct 0x2f47e registrations: 65252 0x33d38, 65261 0x31f30, 65263 0x33164, 65264 0x33f5a, 65269 0x31bce, 65270 0x33e58, 65271 0x342f0. Last, the DM set-ups: DM1 0x323be, DM2 0x3252c, DM3 0x2ef36, DM4 0x329d2, DM5 0x32ae2, DM10 0x32244. These are table entries 3-23. Entries 0-2 (65265, 61443 and DM1 again) come earlier from mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink.
roles.discriminator: The only caller of the 7 direct registrations (through a2 = 0x2f47e) and the only function that registers the PGN 59904 dispatcher. It does no data dump: the current name is wrong.

roles.role: The TSC1 (PGN 0) receive handler. It routes a frame by its destination byte (rx + 2): to processEngineTsc1Request (0x2f128) when the destination is j1939_engine_node_source_address (0x80da01) or 0xff, then to the retarder TSC1 processor 0x2f7e6 when it is j1939_retarder_node_source_address (0x80da0b) or 0xff.

The same order. Both rows take this unprefixed name.

roles.role: Processes a TSC1 frame addressed to the engine retarder. It ignores the frame when total_number_of_engine_brake_output_drivers is 0, the length is not 8, or the control mode (byte 1 & 3) is speed control (1). It stores the control byte (0x801e1e) and the torque byte (byte 4, 0x801e21). It drops the transmission's own frames unless j1939_retarder_shift_assist_enable is set. It removes (mode 0) or refreshes (else) the sender's retarder ignored-request entry, needs a findTsc1SourceConfiguration match, and uses the priority bits (& 0x30) against the controlling sender: a lower value wins, and at equal priority mode 2 is kept and mode 3 needs a larger torque byte. It records the priority (0x801e1c), the torque byte (0x801e1d), the source and the control byte. Mode 0 clears the timeout, mode and device and sets retarder_torque_percent = 125. Mode 2 decodes the torque (0x2f606), selects the stage (0x2f632) as the torque command, and cancels for a transmission shift assist (transmission source, engine TSC1 speed control by the transmission device, fuel_demand_selected at or above the shift assist limit, and a non-zero request); otherwise it sets the timeout and mode 2. Mode 3 sets mode 3, the timeout and retarder_torque_percent = the selected stage.
roles.discriminator: The only caller of 0x2f606 and 0x2f632 (bsr.w at 0x2f980 / 0x2f98e / 0x2fa5a / 0x2fa90) and the only writer of retarder_control_mode outside the initializer.

The same decision flow, but CM848 masks j1939_blocked_message_bits & 5 on mode 0, skips the pointer update for the controlling sender with a jump, and keeps other state words (zero torque timer, speed control flag).

roles.role: Quantizes the retarder torque request (0x80d9f2, 0-100 percent) into a stage percentage in retarder_torque_level_stepped (0x801e2a). Steps: 0 when the request is 0, and 100 in mode 3 when the request is at least 100. Full scale is ROM 0x6055a (stage 4 values [4]) when the stage count 0x801e28 is 4, else 0x6056e (stage 6 values [4]). Then scaled = request x full / 100 (0x801e26). The stage 1-5 lookups at engine_rpm_primary go through the 1-D records 0x801e30... The first stage whose maximum covers the scaled request gives 0 / 17 / 33 / 50 / 67 / 83, or 17 / 33 / 50 / 67 / 83 / 100 in mode 2 (rounded up). It formats no multi-frame response: the current name is wrong.

The disassembly has the same order and constants: request 0, mode 3 and >= 100, stage count == 4 ? 0x5a456 : 0x5a46a, x/100, stage 1-5, 0x11/0x21/0x32/0x43/0x53/100. Only the 1-D lookup call follows each platform's API (CM848 passes a cache word and filtered_engine_speed). Both rows take this unprefixed name.

roles.role: Start-up set-up of the engine retarder TSC1 path, called from mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink (0x28c1e). It sets retarder_torque_percent (0x80d9ee) = 125, retarder_control_mode = 0 and engine_retarder_control_device_indicator = 0, and sets 0x801e28 = the sum of the six cylinder-brake counts 0x808200-0x80820a. It fills the five stage lookup records engine_retarder_torque_stage_1..5_lookup: the x axis pointer (engine_retarder_torque_engine_speed_axis 0x6052a), the stage values pointer and x_axis_offset = 2.

roles.role: Remote throttle claim, run by cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase0 (0x1b55a). With algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.remote_throttle_enable off, it releases its claim: when alternate_throttle_priority equals the remote throttle priority (0x8089a4, CTRMTHPZ), it sets priority 0 and alternate_throttle 0. With remote_throttle_transition_verification_enable off, switch 20 (0x80bcd0 bit 3, e2m DS20SWSS) on claims (a lower priority becomes the remote priority and alternate_throttle = remote_throttle_sensor_state.filtered_value, ADROTHFT) and switch 20 off releases. With verification on, it first updates the hand-over latch 0x801c78. The latch is set when the remote throttle is at or below calculated_commanded_throttle with switch 20 on, and cleared when the calculated throttle is at or below the remote throttle with the switch off. Under a remote throttle fault (status word 3 bit 0x800 set and bit 0x800 of 0x806046 clear) it is cleared when the calculated throttle is at or below the remote throttle. Latch 1 claims and latch 0 releases.
roles.discriminator: The only function that claims alternate_throttle_priority with the remote throttle priority, and the only one that sets or tests 0x801c78 (0x2ed62 only clears it). Unlike the other claimers it releases its own claim.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_claimRemoteThrottleOverride @ 0x50e610, which calls cm848_verifyRemoteThrottleTransition @ 0x50e534: COUNTERPART. CM848 keeps the latch in its own function, mirrors the remote pedal fault bits, gates on J1939 pedal faults / timeouts, and never releases (cm848_selectCommandedThrottle resets the claim each pass).

roles.role: Clears 0x801c78 (remote_throttle_active_flag), the remote throttle hand-over latch of 0x2ec50. Called once at start-up from mc68k_applicationMain (0x28830).

roles.role: The PGN 65230 (DM5 Diagnostic Readiness 1) request responder, table entry 22, registered by 0x32ae2. It builds the 8-byte payload at 0x803458: byte 1 the active DTC count, byte 2 the previously active count, bytes 3 and 4 from ROM 0x60fa5 / 0x60fa7, bytes 5-6 byteSwap16(supported_non_continuous_monitors_bits), bytes 7-8 byteSwap16 of a status word. roles.role: The PGN 65244 (IO Idle Operation) request responder, table entry 7, registered by 0x33ce2 (descriptor 0xfedc00, 8 bytes). Bytes 1-4 (0x8035de) = byteSwap32(scale(0x804fb8 >> 2, 3785411, 1000000)): e2m 117F +18 TIGAIST2 'fuel used ... while under idle' (0.125 gal), giving SPN 236 total idle fuel at 0.5 L/bit. Bytes 5-8 (0x8035e2, misnamed protection_state_enable_flags) = byteSwap32(scale(0x804fb4, 20, 36000)): 117F +14 TITMIS 'time ... while under idle condition' (0.1 s), giving SPN 235 total idle hours at 0.05 h/bit. Then it sends j1939_pgn65244_tx_message. Request only.

roles.role: Builds and sends CCVS1 (PGN 65265). It is scheduled every 100 ms from 70 ms and is table entry 0, registered by cm550_initializePgn65265CruiseControlVehicleSpeedHandler. Byte 1 is 0xf3 or 0xf7 from bit 0x40 of the cruise switch status word (parking brake field); when 0x803d48 is 1, bits 1-2 come from switch 19 (0x80bcd0 bit 2, two-speed axle). Bytes 2-3 are the road speed capped at 0x9c00, x103 >> 6 (mph to km/h), low byte first. Byte 4 holds cruise active / enable / brake / clutch from switch 16 bits and the cruise switch word. Byte 5 holds set / coast / resume / accelerate. Byte 6 is the cruise set speed (0x80a9c6 x 103/64 >> 8). Byte 7 is 0x20 when cruise is active, ORed with 0x80dc2b. Byte 8 holds the idle increment / decrement / test switches.

roles.role: Builds and sends EEC2 (PGN 61443). It is scheduled every 50 ms from 10 ms and is table entry 1, registered by 0x33064. Byte 1 (0x8034aa): 0xf4 / 0xf0 for kickdown from commanded_throttle against the kickdown threshold, 0xf8 on throttle faults. Each fault counts when its status word 4 bit is set and its processing enable bit is set. Bits 1-2 come from accelerator_off_idle, or 3 with idle_switch_override_enable, or 2 on switch faults. Byte 2 (0x8034ab): commanded throttle x 5/8, 0xff with sampled_throttle_override_enable, 0xfe on faults. Byte 3 (0x8034ac): the percent load high byte after cm550_param_lookup_3, 0xfe when j1939_torque_and_load_not_available_flag is set. Byte 4: the remote throttle x 5/8, 0xff when disabled or overridden, 0xfe on its faults. Bytes 5-8 are 0xff.

The current CM550 name is unprefixed with no CM848 namesake.

roles.role: The PGN 65261 (CCSS Cruise Control/Vehicle Speed Setup) request responder, table entry 12 (registered directly by 0x2f538); its descriptor comes from initPgn65261CruiseControlSetupStruct. Bytes 1-3 (0x801efa-0x801efc) are 0x80a9dc / 0x804fc6 / 0x807bf6 (maximum vehicle speed, cruise high and low set limits), each x161/100 >> 8, or 0xff when the value is at or above 0x9e01. Then it sends j1939_pgn65261_tx_message. Request only.

CM848 sends 0xff for byte 1 unless road_speed_governor_enable is set and for bytes 2-3 unless cruise_control_enable is set; CM550 checks only the range. If the judge agrees, the CM848 row needs a cm848_ prefix too.
